records.notes: Table 1 reports stability = 180 h and Ea = 62.2 kJ∙mol−1 for this catalyst; stability is not entered as a performance time_on_stream because the exact conversion/selectivity/STY at 180 h are only shown in a dense trend plot. Selectivity definitions in Eqs. (2)–(4) use product carbon-containing molar peak areas, so selectivity_basis is carbon_molar. CO and CH4 selectivities are plotted in Fig. 4(a) but not printed numerically; not extracted to avoid uncertain bar-height readings.

extraction_notes: Only the paper's own experimental performance data were extracted. Literature-comparison rows in Table 1 other than the 'This study' row were excluded. Fig. 4(b) and Fig. 4(c) contain additional trends for Pt loading and calcination temperature, and Fig. 4(d) contains many stability time points, but the relevant numerical values are not printed in the text/table and the plotted axes/series are not sufficiently unambiguous for exact extraction; these plot-only trend points were therefore not converted into records. Supplementary Figs. S2–S5, mentioned as containing optimization data, were not included in the provided full text.
